blind.description: A stylized wooden screw press mounted on a sturdy four-legged low bench. It features a heavy timber gallows-style frame with a central wooden screw spindle topped by a dual-ended turning lever. Below the press disc sits a round cheese block wrapped in pale cloth/cheesecloth, and an additional completed wheel of golden-yellow cheese rests on the side of the table. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted textures in warm brown wood, mossy green accents on the leg bases, pale cream cloth, and bright yellow cheese.
blind.from_above: Shows the rectangular wooden tabletop with a prominent horizontal wooden T-handle spanning across the center, revealing the circular pressing drum beneath it and a round yellow cheese wheel resting on the plank surface to the upper right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 feet wide.
